name: Moon Observatory Erythr
source:
Erythr wakes up in a field of red flowers with no memory of who she is. The only thing in the back of her mind is that she's looking for someone, and must meet them no matter what.

Just as she's pondering what to do, a boy around ten years-old named Cobalt chirps that he'll help her if she adopts him.

Using Cobalt's ability to see into the future, Erythr will venture to the center of the October world and discover the Magician trapped there.

[From [url=https://moonobservatory.uwu.ai/#upcoming]official website[/url]]
translation:
艾莉丝在一片红花丛中醒来，不记得自己是谁。她心里唯一的念头就是，她正在寻找一个人，无论如何都必须见到他们。

正当她思考该怎么办时，一个十岁左右的名叫钴的男孩叽叽喳喳地说，如果她收养他，他会帮助她。

利用科巴尔特预见未来的能力，艾莉瑟将冒险前往十月世界的中心，并发现被困在那里的魔术师。

[来自[url=https://moonobservatory.uwu.ai/#upcoming]官网[/url]]
